title: lumi-open-data: reference datasets for passport photo specifications, TOEIC score approximation, the Chinese sexagenary cycle, and film stocks
description:
A set of four small, hand-checked, source-linked reference datasets published as machine-readable JSON. Each dataset ships a version, a license, an important_note stating its limitations, and per-row or per-dataset source URLs so every value can be traced back to a primary source.

Contents of this release (counts verified against the JSON files):

  • Passport photo specifications (passport-photo-specs/passport-photo-specs.json) — 45 country entries, each with photo width and height in millimetres, an inch equivalent where an inch standard is commonly stated (otherwise null), background requirement, notes, and an official source_url. This is a 45-country selection, not a worldwide or exhaustive listing. Entries verified in this release carry a verified_on date; entries carried over from the first release do not, and are marked null rather than claiming a verification that did not happen.
  • TOEIC raw-to-scaled approximation (toeic-score-conversion/toeic-raw-to-scaled.json) — 101 Listening rows and 101 Reading rows covering 0–100 raw correct answers, plus a 21-point anchor curve. These are approximations for practice-test estimation only. ETS equates official TOEIC Listening & Reading scores per test form and does not publish a single universal raw-correct to scaled-score conversion table, so this dataset is not an official conversion and must not be presented as one. The values are produced by linear interpolation through anchor points in 5-point scaled-score increments, and the same transparent curve is used for both sections specifically to avoid implying a form-specific official equating.
  • Chinese zodiac sexagenary cycle (chinese-zodiac/chinese-zodiac.json) — 121 entries covering the years 1924–2044, with animal, heavenly stem, earthly branch, sexagenary name, five-element, and yin/yang. Rows are keyed by the Gregorian year in which the Lunar New Year of that lunisolar year falls; dates falling before Lunar New Year belong to the previous row. Derived deterministically from the standard 60-year cycle anchored at 1924 = Jia-Zi Wood Rat.
  • Film stocks reference (film-stocks/film-stocks.json) — 25 entries for well-known photographic film stocks, with type, ISO, format notes, descriptive look characteristics, and a manufacturer or datasheet source_url.

Limitations. These datasets are reference material, not authoritative or regulatory sources. Passport and ID photo rules change and can differ by embassy, applicant age, and printed versus online submission channel; verify against the linked official source before relying on them for an application. TOEIC figures are estimates for practice use only. Film availability, datasheets, and emulsion characteristics change over time; consult manufacturer documentation for technical exposure, processing, or archival decisions.

Licensing. The JSON datasets are released under CC-BY-4.0 (see DATA_LICENSE.md). The accompanying code examples and documentation in the repository are released under the MIT License (see LICENSE). Please attribute as: "Lumi Studio, lumi-open-data, CC-BY-4.0" and preserve the source_url values when reusing the data.
